column1: # note: The 2025 Montana Ordinary Income Tax Rates (instructions page 12), which the worksheet on line 12 calls the Ordinary Income Tax Table. Montana prints no row-by-row table.

# note: Each status has two rows: "$0 but less than" the threshold at 4.7%, and the threshold "or greater" at 5.9% less a fixed amount. Incomes are whole dollars, so the first row is written as not over the threshold less one dollar, and the second as over it.
# note: The tax is income times the rate less the "Less" column: base_tax is minus that amount and of_excess_over is 0.
# note: The rates for net long-term capital gains printed beside them are not covered; the test uses returns with no capital gains.
# note: Single and married filing separately share one set of rows, as do married filing jointly and qualifying surviving spouse; each is repeated for both statuses.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
